The Lobster Principle
Your posture sends a loud signal to
your brain. If you slump, you tell your
internal systems that you are at the
bottom of the pile. Your body reacts
by dropping chemicals that regulate
mood. You feel weaker, so you shrink
more. It is a biological spiral into
chaos.
You snap the loop by taking up space.
Standing tall exposes your chest and
throat to the world. This voluntary risk
forces your mind to switch from fear
to focus. The world treats you like a
victor only when you look like one.
